Crime & Law · India

One Terrorist Killed in Jammu and Kashmir Forest Operation

Security forces killed one terrorist in a joint operation in the Budgam district of Jammu and Kashmir on Friday. The operation involved the Army, Jammu and Kashmir Police, and the CRPF. A search is ongoing for another suspected terrorist. Authorities have advised tourists not to visit the Doodhpathri tourist location due to the ongoing operation in the vicinity. The killed terrorist has been described as foreign by some reports.
